title: Product expansion of a monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates $ in n$, and let $x,y\\in(\\bbr/2\\bbr)^n$. The monomial indexed by $S$ evaluated at the coordinatewise sum $x+y$ equals the sum, over all subsets $T\\subseteq S$, of the monomial indexed by $T$ at $x$ times the monomial indexed by $S\\setminus T$ at $y$.
hypotheses_covered: points x and y in the Boolean cube
